# WIGTN Research

> Methods, measurements and failure modes from AI systems built by WIGTN.

## Reports

- [WigtnOCR](https://wigtn.github.io/wigtn-tech-report/wigtnocr/): A 2B Korean government-document parser distilled from a 30B teacher and evaluated from parsing through retrieval.
- [WIGVO](https://wigtn.github.io/wigtn-tech-report/wigvo/): Real-time Korean–English translation over ordinary PSTN phone calls with dual-session echo gating.
- [WIGSS](https://wigtn.github.io/wigtn-tech-report/wigss/): A browser visual-editing architecture that turns spatial intent into reviewable source diffs.
- [WIGTN Coding](https://wigtn.github.io/wigtn-tech-report/wigtn-coding/): A staged multi-agent workflow with explicit engineering artifacts and release gates.
- [WIGTN Flake](https://wigtn.github.io/wigtn-tech-report/wigtn-flake/): A purpose-driven multi-agent analysis case study built with Snowflake Cortex.
